name: Rotting Orchard
summary: In southern Duskwood, the Rotting Orchard has fallen to the Nightbane worgen. Its fruit once fed nearby Darkshire, but now the trees and buildings lie in ruin.

sections.title: Den of the Nightbane
sections.body: Nightbane worgen have made camps among the Rotting Orchard’s ruined barns and outbuildings. The grove lies east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Withered fruit hangs from the trees as Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush. Nightbane Shadow Weavers practice dark magic among the decaying timber. The fierce worgen Gutspill and Nefaru lead the pack from their lair in the nearby mine of Roland's Doom.

faq.q: What creatures occupy the Rotting Orchard?
faq.answer: Ravenous worgen of the Nightbane pack occupy the orchard. Nightbane Stalkers prowl its brush, while Nightbane Shadow Weavers cast dark spells among the trees and buildings.

faq.q: Where is the Rotting Orchard located in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, southwest of Darkshire. It lies between the ruined Yorgen Farmstead to the west and Tranquil Gardens Cemetery to the east.

faq.q: Who leads the worgen in this orchard?
faq.answer: Gutspill and Nefaru lead the Nightbane worgen from their lair in the mine of Roland's Doom, just east of the orchard.

faq.q: Was this place always overrun by monsters?
faq.answer: No. The orchard once served as a productive farm and fruit grove for the local human populace. Dark curses and supernatural horrors overtook the region and drove the farmers away.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Nightbane worgen threaten Darkshire’s fragile security from just up the road.
As a hunter, you can stalk through the twisted trees and ruined outbuildings. But the Nightbane pack’s keen senses and spellcraft make every approach dangerous.
